title: Personal Checking: overdraft fee refunds already owed come before the Private Client entry test
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of an active Personal Checking account asks to convert it to Private Client Checking and the Private Client entry test is about to be applied to the Relationship Balance. It governs which refunds must already be on the ledger when that test is applied.

## Formal clauses

1. **Owed refunds first.** Before the Private Client entry test is applied, the refund of every overdraft item fee and every extended overdraft fee charged in error on the account is posted first, because pending credits that have not posted do not count. This covers the most recent fee of each kind, as its own bank-error review finds it, and any earlier one, under the general Personal Checking fee refund rules.
2. **Entry conditions.** Before the entry test is handled, both of the following must already hold:
   - "Every overdraft item fee charged in error on the account has been refunded before the Private Client entry test is applied."
   - "Every extended overdraft fee charged in error on the account has been refunded before the Private Client entry test is applied."

   Where either is unmet, the entry test is not yet applied.
3. **Why it changes the test.** Each refunded fee raises the account's ledger balance, and so the Relationship Balance compared with the Private Client entry requirement, by the refunded amount.

## Condition table

| Overdraft item fees charged in error, all refunded | Extended overdraft fees charged in error, all refunded | Entry test applied now? |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

An account with no overdraft item fee and no extended overdraft fee charged in error already satisfies both conditions.

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

The account's ledger balance is 1400.00 USD. An overdraft item fee of 27.50 USD and an extended overdraft fee of 30.00 USD were both charged in error and have not been refunded. Once both refunds are posted the ledger balance is 1457.50 USD, and it is that higher balance that enters the Relationship Balance for the entry test.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "an overdraft fee the bank already agrees to refund can be counted before it posts". **Correct basis:** pending credits that have not posted do not count.
